source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of cloud implications (PDF 160).

blocks.text: Faidon ke saath cloud computing ke kuch asraat bhi hain: data ki hifazat, scalability aur wasail ka intezam, laagat, aur qawaneen o zawabit ki pabandi.

blocks.prompt: Is hisse ke cloud computing ke chaar asraat bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Data security, scalability aur resource management, laagat ke pehlu, aur compliance aur regulatory masail.

items: Cloud ke asraat: hifazat, wasail ka intezam, laagat, compliance.
